title: Harden the resolved /review-code prompt against PowerShell command serialization (second INCONCLUSIVE Codex reviewer)
outcome: Codex reviewer children stop returning INCONCLUSIVE before inspecting files. Evidence: delegation df9ff8e9 (child session-6226, 2026-09-04) serialized the inventory as "git" "--no-optional-locks" "status" "--short" (args.map quoting each token, joined by spaces); PowerShell error: Unexpected token --no-optional-locks in expression or statement; Git never started. Same failure class as the cycle-3 Codex reviewer on the CLI changeset. Platform-level fix (argv-style execution so agents never serialize commands into shell strings) belongs to TermAl; owner decides whether to raise it there.
acceptance: The resolved /review-code prompt states a PowerShell rule: run the worktree inventory exactly as written (git --no-optional-locks status --short); never emit an executable plus each argument as individually quoted tokens; a quoted executable must be invoked with the call operator (&). A Codex /review-code child on Windows completes its inventory on the first attempt. Changed through the ordinary review gate as its own changeset; no product change.
